_comment: Four dated facts per year, 2013-2025. A fact for year Y lands in the `known` set of every cutoff >= Y and the `unknown` set of every cutoff < Y, so each phrase must be UNKNOWABLE before its year: not pre-announced earlier (venues, mission targets, rocket names), and not derivable from the prompt by language or general knowledge alone. 2013 facts are exempt - 2013 is the oldest cutoff, so they never enter an unknown set.
